Options:
  --upgrade  Allow dependency upgrades
  --upgrade-package PACKAGE  Upgrade a selected package
  --check  Check that the lockfile is current
  --check-exists  Require a lockfile
  --resolution STRATEGY  Select dependency resolution strategy
  --prerelease STRATEGY  Set prerelease policy
  --python PYTHON  Select a Python interpreter
  --offline  Disable network access
  --no-cache  Disable caching
  --directory DIRECTORY  Change working directory
  --project PROJECT  Select project directory
